The Story

About Isis

Nashville made her. Nobody else sounds like her.

Isis Aaliyah is Nashville through and through. Based in the 615 she turned real life into bars with confidence style and a voice you remember long after the song ends.

As MS. BACKEND she moves with glam and grit at the same time. Silver shine. Boss talk. Street attitude. Every record is a statement and every stage is a chance to prove it all over again.

Her reach keeps growing on screen and online. She appeared on MYTV30 on Miss Perspectives and built a loyal audience on Instagram where every post shows the work behind the name.
